name: Chiroro-Net Kurashiki No.2 Data Center
notes: Company states it operates a data center in Okayama/Kurashiki with Tier 3-compliant facilities; history records completion of the second data center in Kurashiki in February 2015.

name: BroadCenter Okayama Data Center
notes: BroadCenter official service page lists Okayama Data Center facilities; TOKAI Communications office list confirms an Okayama Data Center in Okayama City, address undisclosed.

name: Okinawa Information and Communications Center
notes: Okinawa Prefecture describes the facility as a publicly developed, privately operated data center in service from FY2015; OCC operates data-center services at the center.

name: FRT Data Center Okinawa
notes: FRT official site and company outline list internet data center operations in Urasoe/Makiminato; AT TOKYO announced an Okinawa access point in the FRT Data Center in 2023.

name: Vantage KIX1 Campus
notes: Vantage broke ground on its first Japan campus in Ibaraki, Osaka, planned for up to 68MW across two data centers; first 28MW facility scheduled for early 2026 operation.

name: EdgeConneX Greater Osaka AI-Ready Hyperscale Campus
notes: EdgeConneX announced construction of a 200MW AI-ready hyperscale campus in Greater Osaka, spanning about 130,000 square meters.

name: Colt Osaka Keihanna Data Centre
notes: Colt announced opening of the Osaka Keihanna site in March 2023; designed capacity is 45.9MW, with official location page describing 45MW fully built capacity.

name: CloudHQ / ESR Cosmosquare Data Centre Campus
notes: CloudHQ and ESR joint venture will deliver 130MW over three phases at Nanko Kita, Osaka; OS1 is 25MW and was announced ready for service in 2025.

name: STACK / ESR KIX01A Kansai Data Centre Campus
notes: ESR and STACK broke ground on the first 18MW building of a 72MW Kansai/Osaka data center campus; STACK markets the campus as a 72MW Osaka data center campus.

name: NTT DATA Osaka OSK12 / Osaka North Campus
notes: NTT official location page describes OSK12 as the first 18MW building on a 36MW campus; DCD reports groundbreaking of Osaka North 1 in Ibaraki City in October 2025.

name: AirTrunk OSK1 Osaka West
notes: AirTrunk official OSK1 page lists Osaka West at 20+MW total capacity; trade press reported construction commencement after the site ceremony.

name: AirTrunk OSK2 Osaka East
notes: AirTrunk announced OSK2 in East Osaka, planned to deliver up to 100MW of campus IT capacity for AI and cloud demand.

name: Digital Edge OSA1 Osaka Data Center
notes: Digital Edge official Japan page lists OSA1 in Osaka Business Park, Chuo-ku, with 2,932 cabinets and 14.4MW.

name: Equinix OS2x Osaka xScale Data Center
notes: Equinix lists OS2x in Minoh, Osaka as its first xScale data center in Kansai, dedicated to hyperscale deployments; public page gives space but not MW.

name: Equinix OS3 Osaka IBX Data Center
notes: Equinix opened OS3 in Osaka in 2021; official facility page lists OS3 in Chuo-ku with 7,467 square meters of space.

name: Genkai Town GPU Data Center
notes: HIGHRESO opened the Genkai Town Data Center in Saga by reusing a closed school as a GPU data center; company history records Genkai Town Data Center opening in August 2025.

name: PDG TY1 Saitama Data Center Campus
notes: PDG/Lendlease began construction of a close-to-100MW Saitama City campus in 2022; Lendlease later announced core-and-shell completion and PDG lists the Tokyo facility in Saitama for AI-ready demand.

name: KIS-DC Cloud-Compatible Data Center
notes: Kistem announced completion and April 2013 operation of KIS-DC, described as Shiga Prefecture's first commercial data center.

name: IIJ Matsue Data Center Park
notes: IIJ official page says Matsue Data Center Park opened in Matsue, Shimane in April 2011, Site 2 opened in 2013, and a system module building opened in June 2025; third-party listing reports 5MW.

name: BroadCenter Shizuoka Data Center
notes: BroadCenter official service page describes Shizuoka Data Center resilience and power systems; TOKAI Communications office list places the Shizuoka Data Center in Yaizu City, address undisclosed.

name: NTT DATA Tochigi 1 Data Center Campus
notes: NTT DATA announced acquisition of 32 acres at Tochigi Inter Industrial Park with plans for two high-capacity data centers totaling about 100MW.
